$comment: One entry per distinct PAGE SHAPE. This is a SINGLE-ROUTE, SINGLE-TEMPLATE repo: the source app renders exactly one route ('/') and has no router. No other template or route exists, and none may be invented.
routeCoverageNote: src/App.jsx renders one page with no router; '/' is the only route and maps to 'home'. Asserted by verify_all.py::check_route_coverage.

home.name: Marketing homepage

wrapper.note: The page wrapper's 64px top padding clears the fixed nav; the hero then adds its own 64px.

notes: Node order is the exact JSX order in App.jsx: Nav, then <main> with Hero, LogoStrip, ProductTabs, KikiTabs, EnterpriseSlider, Results, Statement, QuoteHighlight, CaseStudyCarousel, VideoSection, Faq, then Footer.
proof.results-stats and proof.testimonial share one bare container-medium (no <section>, no padding-global) rendered by Results.jsx -- intentional, it runs edge to edge at 390.
conversion.demo-form and shell.footer are both rendered inside the single <footer> element by Footer.jsx.
Section ids, categories and order are aligned 1:1 with the project's IA (ia.json -> template.home); extraction/verify_all.py::check_ia_alignment re-checks this whenever ia.json is present.
